title: App forgotten by Microsoft
body:
As a power user for MS To Do, it’s sad to see its current state.
This app was the best To Do app I ever tried, and I’m one of your power users. Been using this for years. But this year, I have seen very noticeable bugs. The PC version still works, but the IOS version is atrocious and now borderline unusable. I get the team is probably running on a skeleton crew, but you people need to try using your app for once.
Bugs:
1. Lists get duplicated when adding new lists. Happens every time I add a new list.
2. Tasks become “unclickable”. You click and nothing happens.
3. Tasks can’t be re arranged on the phone. The UI is extremely buggy.
4. Tasks get duplicated sometimes.

Is anyone actively maintaining this? These are really huge bugs for an enterprise product.
Moving to apple reminders for now, because you made the apple unusable on mobile. Hope you improve some day!

title: Recomendaciones
body:
En otra review ya había puesto una serie de recomendaciones, peor hoy usando la app se me ocurrió una idea! 

Sería bueno que los sub task puedan ponerse en “My Day” y se les puede asignar fecha! Esto porque a veces se tiene task que se van haciendo poco a poco y toman más de un día para hacerse entonces poderle poner horarios a los subtask facilitaría montones organizar este tipo de tareas más grandes y tardadas
